preconditions: Select an isolated target, exact artifact and publisher authorization.
cases.action: Later, verify the selected application and Setup artifact signatures and application-control decision.
cases.expected: Record publisher, trust and OS permission separately; do not bypass a denial.

preconditions: Provide two actual accounts, SYSTEM execution context and a recovery console.
cases.action: Later, test user/system installation identity, Program Files/ProgramData DACLs and low-privilege write attempts.
cases.expected: Only the intended identities can mutate executable and system data paths; record actual SID/context.

preconditions: Provide an owned signed installation and a standard-user plus administrator account.
cases.action: Later, test consent cancellation, elevated launch and mismatched or replaced binary identity.
cases.expected: Cancellation leaves no privileged action; only validated owned executable is elevated.

preconditions: Approve only owned disposable processes and preserve a VM snapshot.
cases.action: Later, test readiness ownership, stale PID/creation data and independent process races.
cases.expected: Unrelated or stale processes are not trusted or stopped; readiness binds the owned process.

preconditions: Approve an owned service installation, manual reboot and console recovery path.
cases.action: Later, test service start/stop/restart, unexpected child failure, reboot and single-engine identity.
cases.expected: Normal stop stays stopped; documented recovery and reboot behavior have independent evidence.

preconditions: Name the policy owner and every writer; keep a backup and owned traffic target.
cases.action: Later, compare disk commit, runtime evaluator activation and controlled enforcement as separate observations.
cases.expected: Saved content alone is not reported as active or independently enforced.

preconditions: Approve a disposable trial policy, two cooperative processes and isolated recovery.
cases.action: Later, test trial confirm/cancel/expiry and interrupted history or restoration markers.
cases.expected: Recovery preserves coherent configuration without promoting content hashes to durable lineage.

preconditions: Provide disposable backup inputs, VM snapshot and authority for restore/reimage identity decisions.
cases.action: Later, test multi-file restore, compensating rollback and independent native recovery failure.
cases.expected: Partial restore is barred from activation; unrelated changes survive; old clone requires explicit rebinding policy.

preconditions: Provide an owned executable, owned remote test service and controlled network/profile changes.
cases.action: Later, test native application rules and real HOME/PUBLIC transitions with new connections.
cases.expected: Direction/profile scope and unrelated applications are observed separately; ALLOW does not override other DENY rules.

preconditions: Approve the exact driver-opening and narrow controlled traffic experiment.
cases.action: Later, separately record sniff observation, drop/reinject enforcement, temporary denial and NAT behavior.
cases.expected: Sniff/loopback observation is not enforcement evidence; each claimed effect has its own controlled target.

preconditions: Select a disposable VM and separately authorize process crash, reboot and any physical power-loss experiment.
cases.action: Later, test installation/configuration recovery and old consistent restore or clone with explicit identity rebinding review.
cases.expected: Process termination or server restart is not power-loss acceptance; no anti-rollback guarantee is inferred.

preconditions: Choose VM versus physical targets, duration, workload thresholds and sleep/VPN/NAT cases before execution.
cases.action: Later, observe the already running engine for the approved 24-72 hour workload and physical-target matrix.
cases.expected: Incomplete observation is not PASS; VM results do not establish physical fleet, performance or enforcement acceptance.
